findings.title: Anchor trigger rule says 'above zero' but the message and B5.3 require 'disahkan'
findings.location: B5.6 rule 3; B11 T4/T5; B13 step 7c
findings.fix: Engine runs only if supplyConfirm(anchor).state==='disahkan'; otherwise return trigger.ok=false with reason, show the 'tiada lebihan/kekurangan bekalan yang disahkan' message plus reason; render the flood banner independently; update 7c to assert banner + message + no lists + no exception.

findings.title: 'Disahkan' has two meanings: P3 says bekalan disahkan, P4 says stok belum disahkan; data model has stockVerified:true and 'disahkan (dummy)'
findings.fix: Rename P3 suffix to 'lebihan/kekurangan bekalan dikesan (data dummy)'; remove stockVerified; make stockVerification the constant 'belum disahkan'.

findings.title: Tab click before settle is both queued and allowed immediately
findings.fix: Manual click switches immediately; only the #intervensi hash open waits for allSettled([load, famaScenariosReady]) + 1 frame, with a 3000 ms cap; P4 shows the AMS pending chip until refresh.

findings.title: 'Nothing negative is ever rendered' contradicts pinned margin impact -3.00 pp and legitimately negative margin/spread
findings.fix: Scope the rule to recommended prices (negative/zero/non-finite -> '—' + infeasible text); show margin %, margin impact and spread signed; define handling when beli > jual.

findings.title: Mobilisation 'price at current period' ambiguous; B11 perak overlay figures wrong (actual ~15.29, gap ~+0.62)
findings.fix: Define price used = ivPrice(po,commodity,'Borong').actual averaged over districts; correct B11 figures.

findings.title: Header CSV buttons and footer remain on the new tab and describe/export old-tab data
findings.fix: Keep shared but hide #downloadCsv/#downloadLogistik while the new tab is active, or label them as Pemantauan exports.

findings.title: CommodityPrice lacks 'grade' from the brief's data model
findings.fix: Add grade:null with note 'gred tidak tersedia dalam data sedia ada'.

findings.title: B4.5 says min-max scoring, B5.6 formula is netGap/maxNetGap
findings.fix: Reword B4.5 to 'normalised by the maximum within the list's own eligible set'.

findings.title: Muse recordDates unpinned though prev-week limit depends on earliest recordDate (must be <= 9 Nov)
findings.fix: Pin recordDates, e.g. M09 2026-11-06, M02 12 Nov, M03 13 Nov, M04 11 Nov, M05 13 Nov.

findings.title: Supply rows in MT are generated for Telur Gred A (RM/10 biji), so P3 can show meaningless supply confirmation
findings.fix: Skip supply rows for non-RM/kg commodities (supplyConfirm returns 'tiada') or annotate P3 Telur rows.
